030package dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.products;
031
032import java.sql.Connection;
033import java.sql.JDBCType;
034import java.sql.ResultSetMetaData;
035import java.sql.SQLException;
036
037/**
038 * For H2 metadata DatabaseProductName.
039 */
040public class H2DbSupport extends DbSupportBase {
041  /**
042   * For H2.
043   * @param sharedConnection
044   */
045  public H2DbSupport(Connection sharedConnection) {
046    super(sharedConnection);
047  }
048
049  /**
050   * Create a query that contains the row number of a non "order by" query.
051   * The {@code H2} {@code DbSupport} uses the the {@code H2} builtin
052   * function {@code ROWNUM()}.
053   * It returns a string like {@snippet :
054   * SELECT part_id, part_name, ROWNUM() AS rown
055   * FROM part_data
056   * ORDER BY part_name;
057   * }
058   *
059   * @param selectColumns
060   * @param rownumberColumn
061   * @param tableName
062   * @param trailingClause
063   * @return
064   */
065  @Override
066  public String createRownumQuery(String selectColumns, String rownumberColumn, String tableName,
067                                  String trailingClause) {
068    String query = """
069                 SELECT {selectColumns}, ROWNUM() AS {rownumberColumn}
070                 FROM {tableName}
071                 {trailingClause};
072                 """.replace("{selectColumns}", selectColumns)
073                       .replace("{rownumberColumn}", rownumberColumn)
074                       .replace("{tableName}", tableName)
075                       .replace("{trailingClause}", trailingClause);
076    return query;
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * H2 specific. Should also work with HSQLDB, DuckDB.
081   * <p>
082   * Works with typeNames like "INTEGER ARRAY".
083   * {@snippet lang="java":
084   *     String typeName = rmd.getColumnTypeName(columnIndex);
085   *     JDBCType elemtype = JDBCType.valueOf(typeName.split(" ")[0]);
086   * }
087   */
088  @Override
089  public JDBCType resolveArrayElementType(ResultSetMetaData rmd, int columnIndex)
090      throws SQLException {
091    JDBCType columnType = JDBCType.valueOf(rmd.getColumnType(columnIndex));
092    if (columnType != JDBCType.ARRAY)
093      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column must be JDBCType.ARRAY, not " + columnType);
094    // Assumes first word of column type is element type, eg "INTEGER ARRAY".
095    String typeName = rmd.getColumnTypeName(columnIndex);
096    JDBCType elemtype = JDBCType.valueOf(typeName.split(" ")[0]);
097    return elemtype;
098  }
099}
